name: Dr. Siddhant Arya
summary: Krrish's first villain: a scientist obsessed with a supercomputer that can show the future. Played by Naseeruddin Shah in Krrish (2006).
origin: Arya hired the gifted Rohit Mehra to help build a machine that could see into the future. When Rohit discovered Arya's selfish plans and wrecked the machine, Arya shot him, then kept him in a coma for years, because the rebuilt computer only worked with Rohit's heartbeat and retina scans. Krishna grew up believing his father was dead, and his mother Nisha died soon after Rohit vanished.
powers: Ruthless, will shoot allies and enemies alike

storyline.title: The future machine
storyline.beat: Arya and Rohit build a computer to see the future. Rohit sabotages it, and Arya shoots him and holds him captive.

storyline.title: A prisoner in a coma
storyline.beat: Arya keeps Rohit unconscious because his heartbeat and eyes are the keys that run the rebuilt machine.

storyline.title: Seeing his own death
storyline.beat: The computer shows Krrish killing Arya. He murders Kristian to change that future, but the prediction stays the same.

storyline.title: Island showdown
storyline.beat: Arya shoots his security chief Vikram Sinha and takes hostages. Krrish rescues them and fatally wounds him.

storyline.title: A dark legacy
storyline.beat: Krrish 3 reveals that Arya's experiment on Rohit created the villain Kaal.

gossip.text: Arya's supercomputer was biometrically locked to Rohit's heartbeat and retina, which is why Arya kept him alive for years.
He saw his own death coming, tried to rewrite the future, and failed.
Even after he died, his experiment produced the next film's villain, Kaal.
Krrish's action scenes came from Hong Kong choreographer Tony Ching, and the film won Filmfare's Best Special Effects award.

quiz.q: What does Dr. Arya's machine do?
quiz.why: His supercomputer was built to see the future.
Naseeruddin Shah played the scientist in Krrish (2006).

theme.tagline: He peeked at tomorrow and hated the ending.

timeline.title: Naseeruddin Shah's mad genius
timeline.note: Arya arrives in Krrish as a scientist fixated on a computer that can see the future.

timeline.title: A death he can't dodge
timeline.note: His machine shows Krrish killing him. He commits murder to change that future, but the forecast holds.

timeline.title: Island showdown
timeline.note: Krrish storms Arya's island, frees the captive Rohit and fatally wounds the scientist.

timeline.title: His lab made Kaal
timeline.note: Krrish 3 reveals that Arya's experiments on the imprisoned Rohit created the villain Kaal.
